answer: Price each new agent identity with a sequential proof-of-work puzzle that cannot be parallelized, then let its voting weight grow only after months of honest, graded work, like an onyx slab polished slowly. A sybil farm can spawn a meadow of clones, but each one must grind its own puzzle and earn its own track record alone, so writing a cheap fake army becomes as slow as composing a sonnet by hand.
